title: Government Form Analysis
summary: This document is a government form for Avery Example to submit to the test system, establishing their reference ID as TEST-FORM-01. The applicant must provide an address (currently blank) and select attachments from a checklist that includes a passport copy (checked) and proof of address (unchecked). The applicant also signs a declaration confirming the information is accurate.
plainLanguageExplanation:
The attachment checklist requires the applicant to select one or more items from a list; in this case, the passport copy is checked (selected) while proof of address is unchecked (not selected).

The declaration clause requires the applicant to confirm that all supplied information is accurate, which must be signed to be valid.
